description: A mild Gujarati Thali is a balanced, vegetarian meal known for its subtle sweetness and, generally, low spice levels. Key components include delicate Dhokla or Khandvi (farsan), a sweet-and-sour dal, seasonal veggie shaak, soft rotli, and sweetened yogurt (shrikhand), often served with chaas (buttermilk). It represents a gentle, traditional home-cooked style.
name: Mild Gujrati Thali

description: A Punjabi Thali is a hearty,, traditional North Indian platter known for rich flavors,, generous use of ghee, and buttery dishes. It typically includes Dal Makhani, Paneer (Paneer Makhani/Shahi Paneer), Pindi Chole, and diverse breads like Amritsari Kulcha or Lachha Parantha. Served with rice, lassi, and accompaniments, it offers a complete, indulgent culinary experience.
name: Punjabi Thali
